description: Why agents fail, as OPSIN read it: its readings of an agent's misses on tasks with known answers (the unchanged agent's, or the best agent it built), each way of failing with how many of the misses it read, the ways that were the task's own fault, and the lines it designed from them with where each stands. A reading, not a signed result. Narrow it with suite and thinking.
name: opsin_why_it_fails
